summary: No counterexample or gap was found. Supports of size at most two cannot satisfy the hypotheses; three-site and tied-maximizer four-site cases are consistent with the estimates. The accepted localization applies with exactly the stated normalization, and the canonical costs and minimum capacities retain their predecessor meanings. The proof correctly localizes every maximizer, handles endpoints and reflected intervals of radius one, and bounds arbitrarily large energies and arbitrary finite tail lengths. Both conclusions hold for every maximizer with C_*=1000.
